message-mods.label: Message mods
message-mods.helpText: Enables chat messages to mods for replies to bot accounts. Configure further settings below.

message-users.label: Message users
message-users.helpText: Enables chat messages to users when they reply to bots. Configure further settings below.

send-for-modteam.label: Message for replies to -ModTeam account
send-for-modteam.helpText: Enables messaging for replies to the [subreddit]-ModTeam account.

send-for-automod.label: Message for replies to AutoModerator
send-for-automod.helpText: Enables messaging for replies to u/AutoModerator.

bot-usernames.label: Bot account usernames
bot-usernames.helpText: Comma (,) separated list of usernames for bot accounts that you want to receive reply messages for. Please omit any leading "u/" (e.g., AutoModerator, not u/AutoModerator).

mod-message-settings.label: Mod Message Settings
mod-message-settings.helpText: Please omit any leading "u/" (e.g., AutoModerator, not u/AutoModerator) in the settings below.

mod-blacklist.label: Mod blocklist
mod-blacklist.helpText: Comma (,) separated list of moderators who will not receive messages. Leave blank to send to all mods (except AutoModerator and this app). This setting is ignored if there is at least one username in the allowlist.

recipient-whitelist.label: Recipient allowlist
recipient-whitelist.helpText: Comma (,) separated list of users who will receive messages. Overrides the above blocklist and can include non-mod accounts.

user-message-settings.label: User Message Settings
user-message-settings.helpText: Leave below fields blank to disable.

subject-to-user.label: Subject for message to user
subject-to-user.helpText: This is the subject line for the message that will be sent to users who reply to bots. Available placeholders: {subreddit} (doesn't include r/), {bot} (doesn't include u/)
subject-to-user.defaultValue: You replied to a bot in r/{subreddit}

message-to-user.label: Message to user
message-to-user.helpText: This is the message that will be sent to users who reply to bots. You can use markdown here. Available placeholders: {comment_link}, {subreddit} (doesn't include r/), {bot} & {user} (don't include u/)
message-to-user.defaultValue:
Hi, u/{user}. [Your comment]({comment_link}) in r/{subreddit} was made in response to a bot. The bot's name is u/{bot}.

*This inbox is not monitored. For any questions, please [message the moderators of {subreddit}](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=r/{subreddit}).*

send-for-posts.label: Message for post replies
send-for-posts.helpText: Enable messages for replies to bot posts in addition to bot comments. Affects both mod and user messages.

ignore-mods.label: Ignore replies by mods
ignore-mods.helpText: If enabled, replies to bots by mods will be ignored. This may include other bots that are mods. Disable for testing.
